title: FIXTURE: How I make videos with AI without losing my voice

beats.line: I made this entire video without touching an editing timeline.
Here's the catch: every word is still mine.
The pipeline researches the topic, drafts in my style, voices it with my clone, animates the visuals, and then waits for me.
That last step matters more than you'd think.
In January, YouTube removed AI channels with roughly four point seven billion combined views.

graphic.label: views on AI channels YouTube removed

beats.line: So my job shrinks to three checkpoints: pick the angle, edit the script, and sign off on the cut.
The rule I built this around is simple. The automation replaces the editor, not the author.
